text:
sam: Quick proposal — I want a "staged-diversion" mode for experiments that is header-first, tenant-aware, and uses a small deterministic residual bucket for safety. Idea is: header override > tenant-hash slice > residual (low %) > fallback. Thoughts?

maria: short yes — need to ensure per-tenant quota enforcement and clear fallback behavior (no silent failures). Also want sticky affinity so sessions don't flip.

jing: +1 on deterministic hash. We should use `hash(tenant_id, seed)` not `random()` so rollout is reproducible across services. watch out for sampling bias when tenants are heavy hitters.

sophia: console needs a preview panel: show sample tenants mapped to slices, estimated qps per slice, and a risk score. Also show estimated telemetry cardinality impact (unique slice x model combos).

sam: exact rules I'm thinking (pseudo-config):
```
route "staged-diversion" {
  match header("x-rd-experiment") == "v2" => variant "v2"  // explicit override
  else if hash(tenant.id, seed=73) % 100 < 3 => variant "v2" // tenant-slice 3%
  else if random() < 0.002 => variant "v2" // residual 0.2% for stress safety
  else => variant "v1"
  on_quota_exceeded => variant "v1"
  sticky_by: session_cookie || tenant.id
}
```

maria: two policy notes: 1) `on_quota_exceeded` must use real-time quota check (token/QPS) not eventual counters. 2) sticky_by priority: if header exists, respect it for the request only but don't persist cookie unless allowed.

jing: seed rotation: if we change seed for a re-run we must provide migration mode (map old->new) to avoid sudden churn. maybe a TTL-based remap for a short window.

sophia: UX nit: in rollout wizard show a "Reproducibility seed" field with a tooltip: "Changing seed remaps tenants; use only for major experiments". Provide a sample tenant preview (5 tenants) and a checkbox "persist header overrides".

devx-ux: telemetry: add a flag to include the slice id in traces/logs for the duration of the request. That will let us attribute latency/cost/regressions per-slice without high-cardinality metrics if we only pop it into spans.

sam: good call. For metrics we should emit both: aggregate per-variant counters and sparse detailed logs for a sample of requests. avoids exploding prometheus cardinality.

maria: what about API gateway implementation details? header-first matching is cheap, but hash requires extracting tenant.id — are we guaranteed to have it at the gateway stage?

jing: yes if we require `x-rd-tenant` header at edge or use JWT claim extraction. prefer header because it's explicit and easier for private deploys.

sam: fallback behavior: if gateway can't compute hash (missing tenant header) -> route to `v1` and add a telemetry tag `routing.missing_tenant = true` so we can quantify.

sophia: add a console alert if >0.5% of traffic falls into missing_tenant for a rollout.

devx-ux: small example telemetry query for the console (jaeger/prometheus mix):
```
# prometheus: variant latency
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_sum{variant="v2"}[5m])) / sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_count{variant="v2"}[5m]))
# jaeger: filter spans with tag slice_id
service:gateway span.tag:slice_id = "v2-tenant-sample"
```

sam: ops-bot — can we flag a canary job that enforces per-tenant qps and auto-roll back to v1 if error rate > 2% for the slice?

ops-bot: scheduled canary guard job created: id=cg-2145, watch: error_rate>0.02 over 5m, action=auto-fallback to v1, notify=#incidents + @sam. :robot_face:

maria: OK — final ask: document expected behavior on network failures (gateway -> quota service). We should default to safe path (v1) and increment `routing.quota_check_failed`.

jing: will sketch a small state machine for the gateway handling (compute -> quota check -> decide -> log) and send it later.

sophia: love it. I'll wire the UX mock for the preview panel and seed warning.

sam: thanks all. I'll open a PR with config schema + gate tests. :thumbsup: :eyes:
